name: Cajun Sausage and Vegetables Skillet
why: Sausage-forward skillet: browned smoked sausage plus zucchini, yellow squash, bell pepper and onion, no rice/pasta/potato base. Published nutrition 440 cal / 9 g carb / 21 g protein per serving lands cleanly inside the 400-650 cal, <=35 g carb band with big carb headroom. One-pan skillet scales sanely to 14 with weigh-and-divide. Andouille has no board home (board carries kielbasa, italian-sausage, smoked-turkey-sausage, bratwurst) - flagged as unmapped per the pricer-lane exercise; rebuildable on smoked-turkey-sausage or kielbasa if the selector prefers a mapped substitute.
